UC-820.en: On Windows, Clauseo stops Claude's file tools and its usual file commands from opening or changing another matter's files. It can't stop everything yet: a program Claude writes and runs can still reach them, with only Anthropic's own safety checks in the way; ChatGPT's commands can read other matters' folders; and, until an update closes it, Claude can see the names and sizes of the folders and files of other matters kept in the same folder as this one. For matters that must stay strictly apart, use a Mac.
UC-820.note: Changes when the command scan lands (launch build): the 'until an update closes it' clause goes.
